sources.snippet: It addresses issues in the original dataset, such as overly specific unit tests and underspecified problem statements. The benchmark aims to provide a more accurate evaluation of AI models' software engineering capabilities. On SWE-bench Verified, GPT-4o resolves 33.2% of samples, more than doubling its previous score on the original SWE-bench.
